# apple_app_clip_default_experience (Resource)

Creates an App Clip's default experience: the App Clip card people see when they open the App Clip from the App Store, Safari or Messages. Add a subtitle with `apple_app_clip_default_experience_localization`, an image with `apple_app_clip_header_image` and the invocation URLs App Review uses with `apple_app_clip_app_store_review_detail`. The experience is released with an App Store version, and can't change once that version is released: a new version takes a new experience, so changing the version creates one. Destroying the resource deletes the experience unless its version is released, in which case it stays in App Store Connect. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_clip_default_experience" "card" {
  app_clip_id                       = data.apple_app_clips.app.app_clips[0].id
  release_with_app_store_version_id = apple_app_store_version.example.id
  action                            = "OPEN"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_clip_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Clip; see `data.apple_app_clips`.

### Optional

- `action` (String) Verb on the App Clip card's button: `OPEN`, `VIEW`, `PLAY`.
- `release_with_app_store_version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Store version the experience is released with, e.g. `apple_app_store_version.example.id`. Changing it creates a new experience.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the default App Clip experience.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_clip_default_experience.card
  identity = {
    id = "2f4b6d8a-1c3e-4a5b-9d7f-0e1a2b3c4d5e"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the default App Clip experience.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_clip_default_experience.card 2f4b6d8a-1c3e-4a5b-9d7f-0e1a2b3c4d5e
```
